This section records presentations prepared for seminars, reading groups, and graduate courses.

Entries may include:

- Presentation title and date
- Seminar or course context
- A concise abstract
- Slides or handouts
- Related mathematical notes

Presentations still under preparation remain drafts and are visible locally during `quarto preview`, but they are excluded from the published website.
